anchor.description: UTC recurrence anchor; fractional seconds are truncated. Activation is immediate; a future anchor blocks admission until it starts.

expected_policy_id.description: Current budget_policy_id observed by the caller. Stale transitions return 409.

model_access_group.description: Optional model access assignment committed with the new policy.

transition_id.description: Unique event ID scoped to this user. Retry with the exact same payload.

alias.description: Caller-supplied key alias, unique within this user. Duplicate aliases return 409, including revoked keys. Omit to generate an alias.

secret.description: Returned once; cannot be retrieved later.

token.description: Bearer token for the admin API and UI.

anchor.description: Renewal anchor, normalized to UTC and truncated to whole seconds. Change the schedule through budget-transitions.

budget_usd.description: Nonnegative USD, rounded to nano-USD. Zero blocks inference.

id.description: Optional immutable user ID. Omit to generate one; supplied IDs are used exactly. Duplicate IDs return 409.

model_access_group.description: Model access group. Omit to store the configured creation default.

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
examples: Property foo is required but is missing.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

alias.description: Key alias, unique within its user and matched exactly in key-alias routes.

created_unix.description: Original creation time for this user's key alias, preserved across rotation.

id.description: Internal ID of the current credential version; changes on rotation.

rotated_unix.description: Most recent successful rotate operation, including create-on-rotate; null if never rotated.

status.description: Credential state; user enablement and budget are checked separately.

user_id.description: Immutable user ID, caller-supplied or gateway-generated.

total_usd.description: Absolute replacement total, not an additional charge.

expires.description: Optional future expiration of the replacement; omit for a non-expiring credential.

budget_usd.description: Update the current recurring limit in place, preserving schedule and spending. No policy revision or audit record is created.

model_access_group.description: Replaces the user group immediately for all keys. Omit to preserve the current assignment.

id.description: Immutable user ID, supplied at creation or generated by the gateway when omitted.

adminBearer.description: Admin token or a session token issued by POST /admin/v1/session.

info.description: Internal provisioning and auditable USD cost accounting. Users have a single immutable id, optionally supplied at creation or generated when omitted. User-specific routes and user_id fields use that same ID. Key routes identify keys by alias, scoped to the user. Amounts are decimal strings; *_unix timestamps are Unix seconds. Authentication accepts the long-lived admin token or a short-lived session token from POST /admin/v1/session. Validation errors use RFC 9457 problem details.

post.description: Creates the key for this user's alias if absent, or revokes the old credential and activates a replacement in one transaction. The new secret is returned only after commit. Retrying after a lost response rotates again. Concurrent rotations of the same alias leave only one current credential; a later rotation can supersede a secret before its caller receives it. Other aliases are unaffected. Original creation time and accounting history are preserved.
